{{Quote|What about that Star Destroyer? It's heading straight for us.|Toksi|<ref name="COO" />}}
'''Toksi''' was a [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] [[Soldier/Legends|soldier]] who was a part of the contingent invited to the [[Candoras sector/Legends|Candoras sector]]. He and [[Atticus]] were ordered by [[General/Legends|General]] [[Airen Cracken/Legends|Airen Cracken]] to accompany the [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] and his partner [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]] to fly aboard the ''[[Millennium Falcon/Legends|Millennium Falcon]]'' to a [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Golan space defense platform]] and bluff their way in.<ref name="COO" />
